issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation places the reporting verb 'phán rằng' (says/says that) at the end of the sentence, whereas in the Greek text, 'λεγει ο κυριος' (the Lord says) occurs in the middle of the phrase. This creates a structural confusion where it appears the entire preceding list is what the Lord is saying, but the placement makes the flow of the subject-verb relationship awkward compared to the Greek structure.
